Name: Opac Yuu's  Portraits for Ridgeside Village
Author: OpacYuu
Description:
根据个人喜好制作的肖像，只有PNG文件。包括冬装和沙滩装，除了肯尼斯，我想优化他的肖像。

-目前包括的角色：
-可婚男性：俊、士郎、吉奥、扎恩、安东、肯尼斯（泳装和冬装待更新）
-可婚女性：弗洛尔、基亚拉、黛雅、宝拉、伊莎贝尔
-其他角色：梅芙、阿莉雅、猕猴桃

其他NPC会缓慢更新，大概。

*****如何使用*****
-解压zip文件
-打开文件中的子文件夹，将其中的png图片替换到里奇塞德文件中。例：打开Portraits文件，将图片复制到mods/Ridgeside Village/[CP]Ridgeside Village/Assets/Portraits，替换掉原本的肖像。


———I use translator  :P
This is my first mod so PNG only. Include winter outfits and beach portraits, except Kenneth because I want to improve it later.

-NPCs currently included:
-Male Marriage Candidates: June, Shiro, Jio, Zayne, Anton, Kenneth(winter&beach portraits later)
-Female Marriage Candidates: Flor, Kiara, Daia, Paula, Ysabelle 
-Other NPCs: Maive, Ariah, kiwi

Will update other villagers slowly, maybe.

*****How to Use*****
-Extract the zip file
-Open the subfolder, copy the PNG files and replace the PNG files with the corresponding name in your Ridgeside Village file.
 E.g. Open the Portraits folder, copy the images to “mods/Ridgeside Village/[CP]Ridgeside Village/Assets/Portraits, choose replace.
-Finish!



P.s.我格外注意到黛雅原来戴着眉钉，所以我保留了它。
      I noticed Daia has pierced on her eyebrow,and I keep it.
